_comment: Filing-mapping ratchet baseline (scripts/filing_mapping_report.py --check). placed_cells may not DECREASE; unplaced_figures and structure_findings, and every cell of their breakdowns (unplaced_by_reason, structure_by_table), may not INCREASE. Re-measure with --update-baseline after a deliberate change and say why in _note; never type the numbers.
_note: First bank (rwa-filer Phase 2), extended in Phase 3 with structure_findings. placed/unplaced are unchanged from the first bank: 1911 distinct cells land on a PRA001 v4.1.1 data point; 1025 distinct non-zero figures do not, 816 of them because our IRB sheets (OF 08.01-08.05) are per exposure class while the published sheet axis also splits by approach and SME / non-SME. structure_findings is new: 8 placed facts cannot be filed as generated. STR007 OF02.00.01.01 - rows 0050 and 0060 (and OF 07.00 total sheet c0220) are one data point in the taxonomy and hold different values. STR007 OF08.01.01.01 - c0276 (output-floor RWEA) disagrees with the OF 02.00 c0020 cell that is the same data point. STR007 OF02.01.01.03 - r0080 c0030 (U-TREA) disagrees with OF 02.00 r0010 c0010. STR006 OF08.03.01.01 - c0080 is an integer metric and we report a fractional maturity. The adapter now writes the yes/no cell OF 02.00 r0034 c0030 as true/false, which removed the STR006 it produced in all 13 portfolios before this bank.
